topics.title: When to take Exercise Primary 2 (Basic 2) - Home Economics
topics.content:
HOME ECONOMICS
PREVOCATIONAL STUDIES
FIRST TERM
WEEK 4
PRIMARY 2
THEME - HEALTHY LIVING
PREVIOUS LESSON - Types of Exercise with Demonstration (Primary 2)
TOPIC - EXERCISE
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities - Exercise
2. When to take Exercise
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most of the pupils should have attained the following objectives - know when to take exercise.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The pupils can perform basic exercise.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of:
1. Materials for doing some exercises e.g. sportswear.
2. Pictures or chart showing people doing some exercises.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
WHEN TO TAKE EXERCISE
1. Regularly before sunrise. (in the morning).
2. Regularly after the sunset (in the evening).
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Leads pupils to the field.
3. Ask pupils about the atmospheric condition - whether cold, cool, warm or hot.
Pupil’s Activities - Identify the present condition of the atmosphere.
4. Uses the weather conditions to discuss the appropriate time to take exercise.
Pupil’s Activities - Participate in the class discussion.
3. Summarizes the lesson on the board.
Pupil’s Activities - Copy as instructed.
CONCLUSION
- To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
- Next Lesson - Meaning of Rest - Importance of Rest (Primary 2)
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask pupils to state the perfect time to exercise.
WORKBOOK
WEEKLY ASSESSMENT
1. Sunshine means ___________________.
A. in the morning
B. in the afternoon
C. in the evening
2. Sunset means ___________________.
A. in the morning
B. in the afternoon
C. in the evening
3. ___________________ is in the morning.
A. Sunset
B. Sunshine
C. Sunrise
4. ___________________ is in the evening.
A. Sunset
B. Sunshine
C. Sunrise
5. The best time to exercise is in the morning.
A. True
B. False
C. No
6. The best time to exercise is not in the morning.
A. True
B. False
C. Yes
7. The best time to exercise is in the evening.
A. True
B. False
C. No
8. The best time to exercise is not in the evening.
A. True
B. False
C. Yes
State the best time to exercise.
